 N-PAK AMS 2.5 % v/v B

 2,4-D CHOLINE SALT 32 fl oz/a E

7 LIBERTY 280 32 fl oz/a B 0 e 97 a 97 a 96 ab 99 a 99 a 
 N-PAK AMS 2.5 % v/v B             
 WARRANT ULTRA 3 pt/a E             
 LIBERTY 280 32 fl oz/a E

 WARRANT 3 pt/a E

LSD P=.10 2.7 2.1 2.5 4.2 2.5 1.5 
Treatments 8 and 12, untreated checks, are not shown in table.   
Means followed by same letter or symbol do not significantly differ (P=.10, LSD).
